summary: New Pacific Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its annual financial statements, MD&A, CEO/CFO certificates, and auditor consents for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026. The filing is purely a routine annual reporting obligation of a foreign private issuer, incorporating exhibits by reference into its F-10 registration statement. No transaction, corporate action, or event qualifying as a special situation is disclosed. The filing consists solely of standard financial disclosures and auditor reports. Consequently, no special-situation category applies, and further analysis of deal terms is unnecessary.
